note: Owen Henne (INF), a top portal signee, was drafted by the Cardinals (6th round) and signed pro — he won't join WVU.
Armani Guzman withdrew from the MLB Draft and announced his return to WVU — a big lift for the 2027 infield.
Kyle Casteel (RHP), an incoming signee, was drafted by the White Sox (11th rd) — a possible loss to the 2026 class if he signs pro.
Kyle Casteel signed with the White Sox (11th rd), forgoing his WVU career — the possible loss is now confirmed.
A federal injunction restored a fifth year to the 2022 high-school class — Brenen Lorient is the WVU name to watch, with one open scholarship and the NCAA appealing the ruling.

The same ruling makes six ex-Mountaineers eligible for 2026 — TE Jacob Barrick, DL Eddie Kelly Jr., CBs Jason Chambers and Tyrence Crutcher, S Fred Perry and P Oliver Straw. None has committed to return.
Jason Chambers will use his court-restored fifth year elsewhere — the 2025 starting corner was never on WVU's 2026 roster, so the depth chart is unchanged.

WVU Athletics and Learfield signed a five-year jersey patch deal with Antero Resources — the first in school history, putting the Antero logo on home and away uniforms for all 18 varsity sports starting in 2026-27. Terms undisclosed; Antero, based in Bridgeport, produces close to half of West Virginia's natural gas.

Brenen Lorient is returning to WVU for a fifth season — the July 31 injunction restored eligibility to the 2022 high-school class, and he'll be back in the frontcourt after starting last season for Ross Hodge. He followed Hodge from North Texas and opened his career with two years at Florida Atlantic.
Evans Barning Jr. is no longer with the program, and WVU added guard Jelani McKoy — a redshirt who never played swapped for a rotation-capable guard.
